intro: Trail ranger, grab your broom. We are sweeping hidden treasure into one grand pile!
cheer: Trail cleared! You cared for this space from edge to finish.
indoor-cheer: Crumb treasure collected. Look at that clean floor!
indoor-s1: With a grown-up, make a tape square on the floor. That is our treasure landing zone.
indoor-s2: Sweep the edges toward the middle with steady strokes.
indoor-s2-after: The treasure pile is growing in the middle!
indoor-s3: Corners hide crumbs! Use little strokes to guide them out.
indoor-s3-after: You found the hidden corner crumbs.
indoor-s4: Hold the dustpan still and sweep the treasure pile inside.
indoor-s5: Step back and admire the clean floor. Trail cleared!
outdoor-cheer: Leaf treasure collected. The path looks cared for!
outdoor-s1: With a grown-up, mark a landing zone on the path for our leaf treasure.
outdoor-s2: Sweep the leaves from the path edges toward the landing zone.
outdoor-s2-after: The leaf treasure pile is growing!
outdoor-s3: Corners hide little leaves! Use short strokes to bring them to the pile.
outdoor-s3-after: You found the hidden corner leaves.
outdoor-s4: Bonus step! Ask your grown-up, then jump into the leaf pile and hop back out.
outdoor-s5: Gather the leaf treasure with the dustpan or your grown-up’s leaf container.
outdoor-s6: Step back and admire the clear path. Trail cleared!
